title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Billing Clause: The Settlement Restocking Fee
content:
Billing clause for the settlement restocking fee on a changed-mind return of Northgate Special Order merchandise bought through Northgate Purchases & Returns on a consumer-segment membership (Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club, Club or Club Plus Membership).

## Clause

The settlement restocking fee is the channel's restocking fee percentage of the changed-mind refund posted for the units of that authorization, rounded half up to the cent. Where the purchase holds more than one received authorization, it is worked for the one most recently requested.

- **The authorization** is the purchase's return authorization showing received; with several, the one with the latest requested date. The fee is entered against its sale line.
- **The changed-mind refund posted** is the total of the refund entries with return reason changed mind booked against that sale line.
- **The rate** is a single percentage — the Northgate Special Order restocking fee percentage in the channel's return fee schedule — applied once to that refund.
- **Rounding** is half up to the cent, on the final fee.

## Worked figure (hypothetical refund)

A changed-mind refund of 988.50 stands against the sale line of the most recently requested received authorization.

1. Each percentage point of the rate yields 9.885 on that refund.
2. The settlement restocking fee is 9.885 multiplied by the number of percentage points in the rate, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

If two received authorizations exist, requested on 3 June and 9 June, the fee is worked on the refund posted against the sale line of the 9 June authorization.
